premises.text: Existing social networks reinforce known ties but are not designed to discover hidden valuable connections
premises.evidence_span: they're not designed to actually discover hidden networks of the people that you should be connected with

premises.text: People make only about four valuable connections per year despite huge network memberships
premises.evidence_span: four is the number of valuable, on average, valuable connections being made in a given year

premises.text: iPhone app lets users make, manage, and track introductions on the go with permission flows
premises.evidence_span: Somazi's iPhone app allows you to make, manage, and track valuable introductions on the go

premises.text: Web service broadcasts real-time needs across networks to reach hidden networks of contacts
premises.evidence_span: a web service that allows you to intelligently connect to the masses

premises.text: Dashboard analytics track views, reach, messages, and rebroadcasts of needs
premises.evidence_span: it allows me to track the views, it tracks the reach, it allows me to see the public and private messages

value.text: People connect intelligently to valuable people and opportunities beyond their current reach
value.evidence_span: connect intelligently to the people and opportunities that you don't know, but should

causal_links.evidence_span: make, manage, and track valuable introductions on the go
this number four is way too low
